fields.quote: Side note, because Rex has such an awesome API and we have full control over tab names, I don't like that "genesis m2 cs9" is the default name for the tab. When working on a changeset it would be useful to have a more human readable name.
fields.quote_where: milestone-2 conversation, tab names: the side note on tab names
fields.statement: A change set's tab gets a short human-readable name, not its ID.
fields.wording: the owner's request in the milestone-2 conversation

fields.quote_where: milestone-2 conversation, tab names: item 1 of the tab-names exchange
fields.statement: Tab titles are `<repo>: <change set title>`, the prefix being the repo's handle, for example `genesis: Carving keeps IDs`.
fields.wording: the orchestrator's proposal in the milestone-2 conversation, accepted by the owner

fields.quote_where: milestone-2 conversation, tab names: item 2 of the tab-names exchange
fields.statement: Change sets get a short optional `title` field, set with `change new --title`, under about 30 characters, falling back to the intent's first clause.
fields.wording: the orchestrator's proposal in the milestone-2 conversation, accepted by the owner

fields.quote_where: milestone-2 conversation, tab names: item 3 of the tab-names exchange
fields.statement: No state in the tab title, since Rex shows agent status; the step is added after ` · ` only when it isn't the build step.
fields.wording: the orchestrator's proposal in the milestone-2 conversation, accepted by the owner

fields.quote_where: milestone-2 conversation, tab names: item 4 of the tab-names exchange
fields.statement: The branch `cs/<slug>` and worktree `<repo>.<slug>` are named from the same title.
fields.wording: the orchestrator's proposal in the milestone-2 conversation, accepted by the owner

quotes.text: Ok I think I like the name. The designs are going to need some work but we've got a good start. I'm going to table that for now, but let's move forward with the name change.

Side note, because Rex has such an awesome API and we have full control over tab names, I don't like that "genesis m2 cs9" is the default name for the tab. When working on a changeset it would be useful to have a more human readable name.
I do like having the project name as a prefix: "genesis: Carving keeps IDs", but maybe we can workshop that a bit.
